identity.review_kind: Independent read-only source/runtime safety review and independent reconciliation of final build evidence.
identity.artifact_scope: Review receipt only; candidate sources were not modified.

scope.envelope: Positive board-declared per-cycle minimum and maximum bracketing nominal; board conditions within 1.65-5.5 V and -40 to +85 C; own absolute input ceiling 1 MHz does not admit arbitrary nominal frequencies.

final_inventory.note: The 61-file inventory precedes and does not include this new independent review artifact.

own_source_verification.interpretation_limit: Programming both native analog banks before enable is supported; the precise hardware bank-switch instant relative to STABLE is not claimed.

static_runtime_semantics.analog: All four independent PDRIVER/PAMP/DRIVER/AMP fields, mode and wait participate in matching. Cold startup programs all settings while stopped, before LSEEN, preserving reserved fields. No post-enable analog rewrite exists.
static_runtime_semantics.gpio: Own LOCK at native LCKR address is inspected with full AF, direction, analog mode, pulls, open drain, filter, RISEIE/FALLIE/HIGHIE/LOWIE. No fictitious SPEED access. LOCK/LCKR alternatives preserve the old family layouts. Crystal uses PC14/PC15; bypass changes only PC14 analog selection and permits PC15 general use.
static_runtime_semantics.rtc: All 13 own reset rows are checked twice; CR0/CR1/CR2/IER/ISR precede compensation/calendar/alarms/timestamp/AWTARR. ALARMA is 0x04120000, ALARMB 0x00120000. No KEY/ACCESS/ICR write or retained reset is used for inspection.
static_runtime_semantics.autotrim: Automatic calibration, enabled calibration, reserved mode and reserved source are rejected, including the implicit LSI consumer in LSI-calibration mode independent of SRC. No standalone AWT is substituted.
static_runtime_semantics.uart: Exact UART1/UART2/UART3 roster, source selections 2=LSE and 3=LSI. L052 uses native sorce(); older cohorts retain source(). No TXEN/RXEN-only idle inference.
static_runtime_semantics.lptim_lcd: Both LSE and LSI paths inspect local enable/selectors only if the documented work gate is already on. A disabled gate remains off; neither is temporarily probe-enabled. Gate changes during inspection are rejected.
static_runtime_semantics.direct_outputs: LSE PB12 AF3 and PF1 AF1 selections remain conservative retained owners. LSI PC4 AF6 is present only on R8S6/R8T6; absent on C8T6. No imported PB11 rule for L052. GPIO LSI filter selection is included.
static_runtime_semantics.lsi_trim: Factory address 0x00100A02 is read as a halfword; erased 0xffff is rejected and the 10-bit trim field is used. Factory-matched live LSI is preserved. Mismatched trim requires repeated stopped/unused checks, both stable indications low, no ready observer/pending flag or HSE/LSE detector, and the complete reviewed consumer graph. WAIT and reserved fields are preserved.
static_runtime_semantics.reuse_and_ccs: Matching inherited LSE is verified without reconfiguration. LSECCS and stable enabled factory LSI are required; monitored trim/wait stay frozen. HSECCS, CLKCCS and LSELOCK are preserved. LSE is not stopped to obtain a preferred configuration.
static_runtime_semantics.none: The added Option branches perform no LSE-specific MMIO when config.lse is None; the existing inherited-state path remains.
static_runtime_semantics.failure_ownership: Requested and inherited pads are captured before backend initialization and never released during the boot. Timeout retains source enable and necessary detector LSI, clears no other-owner flags, and publishes no usable LSE capability. LSE control can survive ordinary reset; POR-only retention is disclosed.
static_runtime_semantics.capability: LseClock consumes SYSCTRL and physical pads, verifies the frozen source, uses declared bounds, and retains oscillators on Drop. No automatic RTC source fallback, post-fault elapsed-time continuity, waveform measurement or continuous availability is promised.

prior_c8t6_library.note: The original successful C8T6 library log contains Finished and its original summary contains PASS. No numeric prior exit receipt survived; none is fabricated or inferred as a recorded value. The successful command was not rerun.

independent_elf_parsing: actual vector table at selected FLASH origin
matching Thumb reset-vector and entry address
bounded file-backed and memory PT_LOAD segments in exact selected-part FLASH/RAM
entry lies in executable load segment

schema_acceptance_separate.post_test_delta: Only the reviewed L052 SORCE field binding differs from the tested electrical.rs snapshot; legacy SOURCE binding is preserved. The existing seven tests were not rerun on this later byte identity.
schema_acceptance_separate.api_compatibility_limit: awt_source u8 becomes Option<u8> and startup_consumers changes struct-literal/API shape; this review does not relabel it insertion-only Rust compatibility.
schema_acceptance_separate.provenance_limit: The serde model remains a project-authored independent replacement with previous review history; metapac retains adapted upstream ancestry. No legal clearance or publication permission is inferred.

limitations: No silicon execution, oscillator waveform measurement or board electrical qualification.
Static source semantics and normal build/ELF evidence are not hardware validation.
The original C8T6 library numeric exit receipt is absent and remains explicitly absent.
The 11 schema probes and seven generator tests retain their exact recorded scope and hashes; no broader test success is claimed.
The review did not modify candidate or generated source bytes.
